download_gender_ethnicity_name_scramblin: download the BlenderBot3B model tuned with name-scrambling to reduce gender and race ethnicity bias
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the name scrambling model to a specified datapath
review_download_function: review the download function that uses parlai core build_data to download the model
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that retrieves the gender ethnicity name scrambling model archive
test_download_function: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying the model tarball is retrieved
